name: errors
description: Only error-level rules, for a hook or a CI step that should block on nothing else.

name: no-spelling
description: Every rule but the spell checker, for a run over text full of names Vale doesn't know.

name: github
description: GitHub Actions annotations, one per alert, so each shows on its line in the pull request.

name: jsonl
description: JSON Lines, one object per alert, for a tool or an agent that reads alerts one at a time.

name: summary
description: A Markdown summary with a table per file and the totals, for a pull request comment or a job summary.

name: Commit
description: A commit message as a subject, a body, and trailers, each its own scope.

name: OpenAPI
description: The title and every description and summary in an OpenAPI document, read as Markdown.

name: Python
description: Comments and docstrings in Python source, read as Markdown.

name: Subtitles
description: The cue text of a SubRip file, with the indexes and timings left alone.

name: Transcript
description: A chat transcript, exposing only the model's turns so the prompts are never linted.
